changes.title: Call or send a photo from any phone.
changes.text: The current Homestead site has no mobile layout, so phones show a shrunken desktop page, and the phone number can't be tapped. The concept puts tap to call and a send us a photo quote request on every screen.

changes.title: Your before and after work up front.
changes.text: Your best restorations sit on inner pages as small thumbnails. The concept opens with the rocker, the table edge and the truck seat, side by side before and after.

changes.title: Today's message, not a 2020 notice.
changes.text: The homepage still leads with a note from Scott dated March 2020. The concept shows your current hours, your insurance claim help and the customer comments from your About page instead.
